sahneler.metin: A freight train carrying hazardous materials derailed in East Palestine, Ohio.
Suddenly thirty eight cars left the track, and several burned for days.
A wheel bearing had been overheating.
The train passed three trackside heat sensors.
The final alarm came shortly before the derailment.
Crews then burned chemicals from several cars on purpose.
